Point Reyes 的尺度比一张灯塔照片大得多。第一次来，可以把半天交给 B: Point Reyes is much larger than its familiar lighthouse photograph suggests. For a first visit, spend half a day at Bear Valley: learn about the peninsula at the visitor center, take a short geology walk, then choose a comfortable turnaround point in the woods. All three parts share one starting area, leaving time for children to move from exhibits to leaves and for adults to sit down.
先选短线，把车程留在预算里: Choose a short walk and allow for the drive
编辑建议：普通短线留 2–3 小时，不含湾区往返车程；若走到 Divide Me: Editorial timing: allow 2–3 hours for the short outing, excluding the drive from elsewhere in the Bay Area. For Divide Meadow, allow 3–4 hours in the park and adjust to the slowest person in your group.
NPS 当前说明普通日间入园、步行和游客中心及步道口停车免费；餐饮、往返交通、露: NPS currently lists ordinary day entry, walking and parking at visitor centers and trailheads as free. Food, transportation, camping and special activities are separate.
导航直接设 Bear Valley Visitor Center，先保存离线地图: Navigate directly to Bear Valley Visitor Center and save an offline map and return route. A broad search for Point Reyes may lead somewhere other than this outing’s starting point.
带水、简便午餐、能防风的外层和好走的鞋。树林与海岸天气可能不同，不凭出发地的气温: Bring water, a simple lunch, a wind-resistant layer and comfortable walking shoes. Woodland and coastal weather can differ; do not dress solely for the temperature at home.
以 Bear Valley 为中心，走三段不同的风景: Three different stops around Bear Valley
游客中心 → 地震短环线 → 林间折返: Visitor center → earthquake loop → woodland out-and-back
以下停留时间为编辑建议，地图用于定位。只沿当天开放、现场允许的路径行走，体力不足: The following times are editorial suggestions, and map links locate each stop. Use only routes open and permitted on the day; finish after any stage if needed.
建议留 25–40 分钟，看生态与历史展陈，并向工作人员确认当天路况。先用洗手间: Allow about 25–40 minutes for ecological and historical exhibits and to ask staff about trail conditions. Use the restroom and note your parking location. If the building is closed, use outdoor orientation information and start a short walk instead of chasing another opening time.
从游客中心停车区走向野餐区旁的步道口。官方列环线约 0.6 英里；可用 30–4: Walk from the visitor center parking area to the trailhead beside the picnic area. The official loop is about 0.6 mile; allow 30–45 minutes for the San Andreas Fault signs and invite children to spot the offset shown by the demonstration fence. Reading the landscape rewards a slower pace.
第三站 · Bear Valley Trail 林荫段: Stop 3 · The wooded section of Bear Valley Trail
回到 Bear Valley Trailhead，再沿宽阔土路进入树林，事先约定: Return to Bear Valley Trailhead and enter the woods on the broad dirt trail. For a light version, agree to turn around after 20–30 minutes. If everyone wants more, the roughly 3.2-mile round trip to Divide Meadow is an optional extension. Rest there and retrace your steps to the parking area; reaching the coast is a separate undertaking.
按路面、孩子体力与天色收尾: Finish according to the surface, children’s energy and daylight
Earthquake Trail 虽然铺了沥青，NPS 明确提醒部分路面下陷或倾: Although Earthquake Trail is paved, NPS warns of sunken or sloping sections that do not currently meet full accessibility standards; some wheelchair users may need assistance. The packed-dirt route to Divide Meadow includes slopes exceeding 5% and rocky patches, and the meadow toilets are not accessible. For small-wheeled strollers, manual wheelchairs or anyone concerned about uneven ground, ask the visitor center about current conditions and treat the exhibits and nearby usable areas as a complete shorter visit.
给当天留一个明确的终点: Give the day a clear finishing point
孩子开始累、雨后路滑或雾让驾驶变慢时，就回 Bear Valley。建议在仍有充: Return to Bear Valley if children tire, paths are slippery after rain or fog slows the drive. Finish walking with plenty of daylight left, have a snack and check offline navigation before setting off. The lighthouse and distant beaches need additional driving and time, so they make a more relaxed separate outing.

渡轮离岸后，Angel Island 把城市换成山坡、海风与另一种观看湾区的距离: As the ferry leaves the shore, Angel Island offers hills, sea air and a new distance from the city. For a first visit, focus on Ayala Cove and the immigration station, combining walking and bay views with history that deserves time. Many immigrants faced inspection and detention here; leave space to reflect on the poems and personal stories during your visit.

编辑建议：为 Ayala Cove 与移民站留约 4–5 小时在岛上，往返船程另: Editorial timing: allow roughly 4–5 hours on the island for Ayala Cove and the immigration station, plus ferry travel. Pick a feasible return sailing before deciding how long to explore.
旧金山出发查 Golden Gate Ferry，Tiburon 出发查 Ang: For San Francisco, check Golden Gate Ferry; for Tiburon, check Angel Island Tiburon Ferry. Verify each operator’s schedule, ticketing and departure dock separately; do not assume the other operator is an automatic backup.
上岛需交通及入园预算；Golden Gate Ferry 当前说明船票含州立公园: Budget for transportation and park admission. Golden Gate Ferry currently includes state park admission in its fare and advises arranging return tickets before traveling. Some immigration station interiors charge separately; free exhibition spaces also have their own opening arrangements.
带够饮水、午餐、防晒和挡风外套；岛上餐饮、接驳和观光车具有季节性，只有确认实际营: Bring enough drinking water, lunch, sun protection and a windproof layer. Island food service, shuttles and trams are seasonal; include them only after confirming actual operation.
用一条往返线连接码头与移民站: Link the landing and immigration station with one out-and-back route
Ayala Cove → 移民站 → 回码头留白: Ayala Cove → immigration station → time back at the landing
停留时间为编辑建议，步行速度因坡度、台阶和同行者而异。地图只定位停留点，路线以官: Visit lengths are editorial suggestions; walking speed depends on slopes, stairs and your group. Maps locate the stops; follow the official map and on-site signs for the actual route.
第一站 · Ayala Cove 登岛与辨认返程码头: Stop 1 · Arrive at Ayala Cove and identify the return landing
下船后先拍下返航信息，确认登船队列和洗手间位置，预留 20–30 分钟整理背包与: Photograph the return information, identify the boarding queue and restroom, and allow 20–30 minutes to organize bags and read the map. Before following a crowd uphill, confirm whether you are taking the shorter stair route or the longer road option.
The official stair route is about 1 mile one way from the landing with approximately 140 steps. The stair-free route is about 1.5 miles and still steep in places. Allow walking time for your group, then roughly 60–90 minutes for exhibits. Check opening and admission that day and distinguish the detention barracks from the immigration museum in the former hospital.
第三站 · 返回 Ayala Cove 草地与码头: Stop 3 · Return to the Ayala Cove lawn and ferry landing
按来时已确认的路线返回，先到码头附近，再决定是否野餐或看水面。建议把计划回船前: Return by the route you already checked. Reach the landing area before deciding whether to picnic or watch the water. As an editorial planning target, be back at Ayala Cove 30 minutes before your chosen boat. Golden Gate Ferry separately recommends reaching the dock about 15 minutes before departure; that is not the time to start walking from the museum.
把无障碍、家庭节奏和天气放进同一个计划: Plan mobility, family pace and weather together
免台阶并不等于平路。州立公园说明去移民站的道路有陡坡，只向电量充足的强动力电动轮: Stair-free does not mean level. State Parks notes steep hills on the longer road to the immigration station and recommends it only for power-wheelchair users with sufficient battery and capability. Manual-wheelchair users should contact the park in advance about workable assistance. Staff rides and commercial shuttles are not guaranteed on arrival and may not accommodate power wheelchairs or visitors unable to transfer to a vehicle seat. With small strollers or young children, the Ayala Cove lawn, visitor center area and a picnic can form a complete shorter visit.
风起或时间不足时，先缩短路线: Shorten the walk when wind or time calls for it
雾天不保证看见完整城市天际线，大风天先看航运提醒；返程受影响时及时向船员确认安排: Fog can hide the skyline; check ferry alerts when wind is strong and ask the crew about arrangements if return service is affected. A first visit need not include both the summit and the full island circuit. Turn back immediately if your current pace leaves too little time to reach the landing. Check current fire, trail and facility notices, carry your own water and do not rely on a last-minute shuttle to catch the boat.
核对出发日的去程、回程、营运商和码头，保存票务信息。: Check outbound and return sailings, operator and docks for your date, and save ticket details.

选择台阶路线或较长道路路线，设置折返和到码头提醒。: Choose the stair route or longer road route and set turnaround and dock-arrival reminders.
